title: totalPaid floors at 0 on a net-positive call and NudgePaid emits the snapshot rather than the delivered amount
description: (a) `totalPaid = paymentAmount > remaining ? paymentAmount - remaining : 0` reports 0 net spend whenever the contract held a pre-existing payment-token balance — i.e. it reads as 'free batch' on exactly the transaction where the caller took someone else's pot. (b) `NudgePaid(recipient, token, amount)` emits `snapshot[i]`, over-reporting delivery on any fee-on-transfer or negatively-rebasing token.
impact: No direct loss. (a) totalPaid = paymentAmount > remaining ? paymentAmount - remaining : 0 reports 0 net spend whenever the contract held a pre-existing payment-token balance — i.e. it reads as a 'free batch' on EXACTLY the transaction where the caller took someone else's pot. (b) NudgePaid(recipient, token, amount) emits snapshot[i], over-reporting delivery on any fee-on-transfer or negatively-rebasing token.
attackPath: Not an attack path. Any indexer, accounting job or UI keyed on totalPaid or NudgePaid inherits the error, on precisely the paths where value moved unexpectedly.
likelihood: certain whenever CLASS-002 or CLASS-008 fires.
justification: QA — incorrect state reporting with no value impact of its own. Its significance is that it blinds off-chain monitoring on exactly the transactions that matter most (the sweep and the under-funded batch), so it should be fixed alongside CLASS-002/CLASS-008 rather than deferred.

poc.note: Source re-derivation of the totalPaid floor and NudgePaid emission.
